LightningComponentBundle.description: Displays field change history captured in Big Objects for the current record as a filterable, paginated timeline with permission-gated CSV export.

property.name: title
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Heading shown on the component card.

property.name: pageSize
property.label: Page Size
property.description: Number of change rows fetched per page (1-200).

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record Id
property.description: Record whose field history is displayed.
